provenance.name: NASA GRACE & GRACE-FO Level-3 JPL Tellus Monthly Land Water-Equivalent-Thickness
provenance.provider: NASA JPL / PO.DAAC (Physical Oceanography Distributed Active Archive Center)
provenance.license: NASA Open Data Policy (CC0 Equivalent / Demonstration Benchmark)
provenance.citation: JPL. 2019. GRACE Tellus Monthly Mass Grids - Land (RL06 v04). Ver. RL06 v04. PO.DAAC, CA, USA. https://doi.org/10.5067/TELND-3AJ64. Scientific algorithm: Landerer, F. W. and S. C. Swenson (2012), Accuracy of scaled GRACE terrestrial water storage estimates. Water Resources Research, 48(4), W04531.
provenance.spatialResolution: 300 km equivalent Gaussian smoothing footprint (~3 degrees), gridded to 0.5 degrees
provenance.processingLineage: Authentic NASA PO.DAAC Level-3 Land Mass Grids (RL06 v04 & RL06.3 v04) spanning 2014-01 through 2024-12. Nearest centroid Haversine extraction with 300 km Gaussian smoothing footprint.
knownLimitations: GRACE/GRACE-FO measures vertically integrated column mass anomaly (liquid water equivalent in cm), combining groundwater, vadose zone soil moisture, surface water, and biomass.
Coarse spatial resolution (~300 km Gaussian footprint); MUST NOT be interpreted directly as single-borewell water table elevation without independent mass decoupling.
The 11-month inter-mission gap (2017-07 to 2018-05) and spacecraft battery conservation outages are strictly preserved as unobserved null discontinuities.

provenance.name: NASA GPM IMERG Synthesized Climatological Rainfall (Demonstration)
provenance.provider: Terranexus Simulation Fixture (Climatological Model Calibrated to IMERG Literature)
provenance.license: NASA Open Earth Science Data Policy (Public Domain / Demonstration Benchmark)
provenance.citation: Huffman, G. J., et al. (2020), GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07, Greenbelt, MD, Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC), https://doi.org/10.5067/GPM/IMERG/3B-MONTH/07.
provenance.spatialResolution: 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree (~10 km x 10 km equivalent)
provenance.processingLineage: Illustrative rainfall series. Not downloaded NASA GPM IMERG observations. Climatological monthly synthesis calibrated against regional IMD and NASA GPM IMERG literature distributions and historical annual aggregates (Huffman et al. 2020).
knownLimitations: Illustrative rainfall series. Not downloaded NASA GPM IMERG observations.
Precipitation is surface atmospheric input and does not equal aquifer recharge (which is modulated by evapotranspiration, infiltration, and soil vadose mechanics).
Synthesized from monthly regional percentage distributions, not direct satellite microwave sensor radiometry.

provenance.name: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB) Regional Benchmark Records (Demonstration)
provenance.provider: Terranexus Demonstration Fixture (Calibrated to CGWB Published Regional Yearbooks)
provenance.license: Government of India Open Data License (GODL-India) / Demonstration Benchmark
provenance.citation: Central Ground Water Board (2024), Ground Water Year Book - State-wise Periodic Monitoring Reports (2014-2024), Ministry of Jal Shakti, New Delhi.
provenance.spatialResolution: Illustrative Regional Coordinate (Derived from District Reports)
provenance.processingLineage: Illustrative regional groundwater benchmark synthesized from published CGWB regional groundwater yearbooks and district information booklets. Not an authenticated CGWB monitoring-well observation.
knownLimitations: Illustrative regional groundwater benchmark. Not an authenticated CGWB monitoring-well observation.
Point measurements reflect localized conceptual hydraulic head at the well screen depth only.
Station codes are prefixed with DEMO- and do not represent verified CGWB National Hydrograph Network site identifiers.
Piezometric head indicates water table elevation, not total volumetric storage capacity of the regional aquifer.
